failure.message:
Expected: less than or equal to 1280
  But was:  1467.53516f

root_cause: ShowHome captures/restores HomeWorldSnapshot. After the completed side-route return the hero remains at(.30,.95), not square(0,-.25). The fixture rebuilds Home but forces the camera to(0,-.05) and assumes fresh original residents, so actor yMax1467.535 exceeds the1280 portrait. NPC positions are also carried, risking an offscreen greeting.
correction: Complete and assert real routes first, then release the portrait camera and load a separate isolated Home scene via the existing EnterHome fixture. Verify new controller, null transient snapshot, hero square and original Momo anchor. Derive crop after full projection, retain every-frame crop containment and all movement/save checks. Do not alter production snapshot persistence or reposition the routed hero as a rescue.
